What is PEP 8 and why does it matter?

Supplied answer
PEP 8 is the official style guide for Python code: 4 spaces for indentation, snake_case for variables and
functions, PascalCase for class names, UPPER_CASE for constants, lines up to 79 characters, and
blank lines between functions. Interviewers notice clean, consistent code even in a small program.

Preserved as supplied; not independently validated or executed
